source.text: יְהוָ֣ה מָלָךְ֮ גֵּא֪וּת לָ֫בֵ֥שׁ לָבֵ֣שׁ יְ֭הוָה עֹ֣ז הִתְאַזָּ֑ר אַף־תִּכּ֥וֹן תֵּ֝בֵ֗ל בַּל־תִּמּֽוֹט׃

records.literal_gloss: YHWH reigns; [with] majesty he is clothed; clothed [is] YHWH, [with] strength he has girded himself; indeed, [the] world is established; not it will be shaken.

en.L: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} reigns; [with] majesty {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} is clothed; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is clothed; [with] strength {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} has girded {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}}. \q Indeed, the world is established; it will not be shaken.
en.B: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} is King! He has put on majesty like a robe; \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} has dressed {{deity_pronoun:himself|Himself}} and tied on strength like a belt. \q The world stands firm; nothing can shake it.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} rules as King! He wears greatness like a royal robe. \q He wears strength like a belt, ready to act. \q The world stands firm, and nothing can move it.

fr.L: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} règne ; [de] majesté {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} est vêtu ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est vêtu ; [de] force {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} s’est ceint. \q Oui, le monde est affermi ; il ne sera pas ébranlé.
fr.B: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est roi ! Il a revêtu la majesté comme un manteau ; \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est habillé, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a noué la force comme une ceinture. \q Le monde tient ferme ; rien ne peut l’ébranler.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} règne comme roi ! Il porte la grandeur comme un manteau royal. \q Il porte la force comme une ceinture, prêt à agir. \q Le monde tient bon, et rien ne peut le faire bouger.

sw.L: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anatawala; amevikwa enzi; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amevikwa; amejifunga nguvu. \q Naam, ulimwengu umethibitishwa; hautatikisika.
sw.B: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mfalme! Amevaa enzi kama joho; \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} amejivika, akajifunga nguvu kama mshipi. \q Ulimwengu umesimama imara; hakuna kitakachoutikisa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} anatawala kama Mfalme! Anavaa ukuu kama joho la kifalme. \q Anavaa nguvu kama mshipi, yuko tayari kutenda. \q Ulimwengu umesimama imara, wala hakuna kitakachouondoa.

es.L: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} reina; [de] majestad está vestido; \q vestido está {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; [de] poder se ha ceñido. \q Ciertamente, el mundo está afirmado; no será sacudido.
es.B: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es Rey! Se ha puesto la majestad como un manto; \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se ha vestido y se ha ceñido de poder como con un cinturón. \q El mundo está firme; nada lo puede sacudir.
es.R: ¡{{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} gobierna como Rey! Lleva su grandeza como un manto real. \q Lleva su poder como un cinturón, listo para actuar. \q El mundo está firme, y nada lo puede mover.

decisions.choice: reigns: is King, has taken his throne
decisions.reason: The verb (malak) can mean "is king" or "has become king". The same cry opens 96:10, 97:1 and 99:1; with Psalms 47 and 95-99 these psalms celebrate the LORD as King.
A king's robe shows his majesty; to gird oneself is to tie up the robe with a belt, ready to act (18:33; 65:7).

decisions.choice: a psalm for the sixth day
decisions.reason: Psalm 93 has no title in the Hebrew. The Mishnah (Tamid 7:4) lists it as the psalm sung in the temple on the sixth day of the week, and the ancient Greek translation gives it a title for the day before the Sabbath.
Balanced and Readable bring out the shout that the LORD is King (m1).

records.literal_gloss: Established [is] your throne from then; from everlasting [are] you.

en.L: Established [is] {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} throne from of old; \q from everlasting [are] {{deity_pronoun:you|You}}.
en.B: Your throne has stood firm from ancient days; \q {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have always been.
en.R: Your throne has been secure since time began. \q You have always existed.

fr.L: Affermi [est] {{deity_pronoun:ton|Ton}} trône depuis jadis ; \q depuis toujours [es-]{{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}}.
fr.B: Ton trône tient ferme depuis les temps anciens ; \q {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as toujours existé.
fr.R: Ton trône est solide depuis le début des temps. \q Tu as toujours existé.

sw.L: Kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi kimethibitishwa tangu zamani; \q tangu milele [ndiwe] {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}}.
sw.B: Kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi kimesimama imara tangu siku za kale; \q {{deity_pronoun:wewe|Wewe}} umekuwako siku zote.
sw.R: Kiti {{deity_pronoun:chako|Chako}} cha enzi kimekuwa imara tangu mwanzo wa nyakati. \q Wewe umekuwako siku zote.

es.L: Afirmado [está] {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} trono desde entonces; \q desde la eternidad [eres] {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}}.
es.B: Tu trono está firme desde tiempos antiguos; \q {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has existido siempre.
es.R: Tu trono ha estado seguro desde que comenzó el tiempo. \q Tú siempre has existido.

decisions.choice: established: the same word as the world in verse 1
decisions.reason: The world is established (verse 1) because God's throne is established (kun in both). His rule is older than the world.

decisions.choice: from then, from everlasting: from the beginning, with no beginning
decisions.reason: "From then" (me'az) is from the earliest time; "from everlasting" ('olam) goes back beyond it (90:2).

source.text: נָשְׂא֤וּ נְהָר֨וֹת׀יְֽהוָ֗ה נָשְׂא֣וּ נְהָר֣וֹת קוֹלָ֑ם יִשְׂא֖וּ נְהָר֣וֹת דָּכְיָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: The rivers have lifted up, YHWH, the rivers have lifted up their voice; the rivers lift up their pounding.

en.L: [The] rivers have lifted up, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, \q [the] rivers have lifted up their voice; \q [the] rivers lift up their pounding.
en.B: The rivers have risen, {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}; \q the rivers have raised their roar; \q the rivers lift high their crashing waves.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, the floods have risen. \q They roar loudly. \q Their waves crash and pound.

fr.L: [Les] fleuves ont élevé, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q [les] fleuves ont élevé leur voix ; \q [les] fleuves élèvent leur fracas.
fr.B: Les fleuves ont monté, {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} ; \q les fleuves ont élevé leur grondement ; \q les fleuves soulèvent leurs vagues qui se brisent.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, les flots ont monté. \q Ils grondent très fort. \q Leurs vagues se brisent et cognent.

sw.L: Mito imeinua, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q mito imeinua sauti yake; \q mito inainua mshindo wake.
sw.B: Mito imefurika, Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}; \q mito imepaza ngurumo yake; \q mito inainua juu mawimbi yake yanayopiga.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, mafuriko yamepanda. \q Yanavuma kwa sauti kuu. \q Mawimbi yake yanapiga na kugonga.

es.L: Alzaron [los] ríos, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q alzaron [los] ríos su voz; \q alzan [los] ríos su estruendo.
es.B: Los ríos han crecido, {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}; \q los ríos han levantado su rugido; \q los ríos alzan en alto sus olas que rompen.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, las aguas han crecido. \q Rugen con fuerza. \q Sus olas chocan y golpean.

decisions.choice: the rivers: the waters of chaos
decisions.reason: The rivers and the sea (verse 4) stand for the powers that rage against God's order, the waters he tamed at creation and at the Red Sea (74:13; 89:10-11; 46:3-4).
The word (dokhi) is found only here; from a verb meaning to crush, it is the pounding of breakers.
The line is said three times, each time growing (92:10), like waves rising.

source.text: מִקֹּל֨וֹת׀מַ֤יִם רַבִּ֗ים אַדִּירִ֣ים מִשְׁבְּרֵי־יָ֑ם אַדִּ֖יר בַּמָּר֣וֹם יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: More than [the] sounds of many waters, majestic [than] [the] breakers of [the] sea, majestic in the height [is] YHWH.

en.L: More than the sounds of many waters, \q more majestic than the breakers of the sea, \q majestic on high [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Above the roar of the great waters, \q above the crash of the ocean's breakers, \q {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is majestic on high.
en.R: The floods roar loudly, \q and the ocean's waves are strong, \q but {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in heaven is far greater.

fr.L: Plus que les voix des grandes eaux, \q plus majestueux que les brisants de la mer, \q majestueux dans les hauteurs [est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Plus fort que le grondement des grandes eaux, \q plus fort que le fracas des brisants de l’océan, \q {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est majestueux dans les hauteurs.
fr.R: Les flots grondent très fort, \q et les vagues de l’océan sont puissantes, \q mais {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, dans le ciel, est bien plus grand.

sw.L: Kuliko sauti za maji mengi, \q mkuu kuliko mawimbi ya bahari, \q mkuu juu [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Juu ya ngurumo ya maji makuu, \q juu ya mshindo wa mawimbi ya bahari, \q {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni mkuu juu mbinguni.
sw.R: Mafuriko yanavuma kwa sauti kuu, \q na mawimbi ya bahari yana nguvu, \q lakini {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliye mbinguni ni mkuu zaidi sana.

es.L: Más que el estruendo de las muchas aguas, \q más majestuoso que las rompientes del mar, \q majestuoso en lo alto [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}.
es.B: Por encima del rugido de las grandes aguas, \q por encima del estrépito de las olas del océano, \q {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es majestuoso en lo alto.
es.R: Las aguas rugen con fuerza, \q y las olas del océano son poderosas, \q pero {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, en el cielo, es mucho más grande.

decisions.reason: The opening "than" (min) governs both lines: the LORD is greater than the waters and greater than the breakers. Some read "majestic" with the waters ("the majestic breakers"); the sense is the same.
The word ('addir) is used of the sea's power and then of the LORD's: whatever the sea has, he has more (8:2).
"Many waters" is a fixed phrase for overwhelming waters (18:17; 29:3).

source.text: עֵֽדֹתֶ֨יךָ׀נֶאֶמְנ֬וּ מְאֹ֗ד לְבֵיתְךָ֥ נַאֲוָה־קֹ֑דֶשׁ יְ֝הוָ֗ה לְאֹ֣רֶךְ יָמִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: Your testimonies are reliable exceedingly; to your house holiness is fitting, YHWH, for length of days.

en.L: Your testimonies are very reliable; \q holiness befits {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house, \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for length of days.
en.B: Your decrees can be fully trusted; \q holiness suits {{deity_pronoun:your|Your}} house, \q {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, for all time to come.
en.R: {{divine_name:LORD|Yahweh}}, everything {{deity_pronoun:you|You}} have said can be fully trusted. \q Your house will be holy forever.

fr.L: Tes témoignages sont très sûrs ; \q la sainteté convient à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison, \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour la longueur des jours.
fr.B: On peut se fier entièrement à {{deity_pronoun:tes|Tes}} décrets ; \q la sainteté sied à {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} maison, \q {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, pour tous les temps à venir.
fr.R: {{divine_name:SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, on peut avoir entièrement confiance en tout ce que {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} as dit. \q Ta maison sera sainte pour toujours.

sw.L: Shuhuda {{deity_pronoun:zako|Zako}} ni za kuaminika sana; \q utakatifu unaifaa nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, \q Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa wingi wa siku.
sw.B: Maagizo {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} yanaaminika kabisa; \q utakatifu unaifaa nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}}, \q Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kwa nyakati zote zijazo.
sw.R: Ee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kila ulichosema kinaaminika kabisa. \q Nyumba {{deity_pronoun:yako|Yako}} itakuwa takatifu milele.

es.L: Tus testimonios son muy fieles; \q la santidad conviene a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} casa, \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por largos días.
es.B: Tus decretos son del todo dignos de confianza; \q la santidad le sienta bien a {{deity_pronoun:tu|Tu}} casa, \q {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, por todos los tiempos venideros.
es.R: {{divine_name:SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, todo lo que {{deity_pronoun:tú|Tú}} has dicho es digno de toda confianza. \q Tu casa será santa para siempre.

decisions.reason: The word ('edot) is used of the terms of the covenant (19:8; 119:2). Beside the firm world and throne (verses 1-2), God's word also stands firm.
The King's house is his temple, which must be kept holy (5:8; 24:3-4).

decisions.choice: is fitting: is right for, adorns
decisions.reason: The verb (na'ah) means to be fitting or beautiful (33:1).
Readable says what the testimonies are (m1).
